title: Interactive: Tracking negotiating texts at the COP17 biodiversity summit
content:
Next week, diplomats from around the world will descend on Yerevan, Armenia, to negotiate a series of decisions under the UN Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD). 

Between 19 and 30 October, 196 parties will gather to hammer out the precise wording of the dozens of legal texts that make up the decisions under the Conference of the Parties (COP) to the CBD.

This year’s summit is particularly significant, as it marks the halfway point between the agreement of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework and the deadline for achieving its targets.

The CBD has found that countries are currently not on track to meet 22 out of the framework’s 23 targets. 

During the fortnight, delegates will also be negotiating decisions relating to the two supplemental protocols to the CBD: the Cartagena Protocol, which covers biosafety; and the Nagoya Protocol, which covers access and benefit-sharing for the use of genetic resources. 

(The Cartagena and Nagoya Protocols, which are each governed by a “meeting of the parties”, or “MOP”, have fewer parties than the CBD as a whole, with 173 and 141, respectively.)

title: CMI’s next chapter: reflections by departing CEO Janne Taalas and Acting CEO Hanna Klinge
content:
As CEO Janne Taalas moves to a new position as Finland’s Permanent Representative to the United Nations, Hanna Klinge takes over as Acting CEO from 12th October. In this joint piece, they reflect on how CMI and the field have changed during Taalas’ incumbency.

Over the past five years, the international landscape has changed profoundly. Geopolitical competition has intensified, major wars have returned to the centre of international politics, and the international system has become more fragmented. These developments have reshaped the ways in which conflicts can be managed and resolved.

This period has also reinforced a fundamental lesson: military force rarely resolves the political questions that drive conflict. At the same time, as the world invests more heavily in preparing for war, the need for mediation continues to grow.

title: Click, Clue, Escape: making copyright training an adventure
content:
Erica Levi is the copyright lead at Lanchester Library, Coventry University. This is the second in a series of posts from her. Her team specialises in embedding Open Educational Resources in teaching at the university.  She advises and trains colleagues on copyright and licences. Since copyright still seems like a dreary topic for most colleagues, Erica sets herself a mission to develop online educational games. She writes…..

I have come to recognise a reaction when I tell people my job involves copyright: the familiar glazing over of the eyes.

That has always bothered me. Advocating for copyright and helping colleagues engage with it are important parts of my role. But how do you make copyright interesting?

A straightforward training session can easily become a long list of dos and don’ts, and lists do not necessarily inspire. So, I started experimenting with something different: storytelling through games.

From telling to doing

Stories help us make sense of information and encourage us to care about what happens next. Games take this a step further by asking us to do something.

Combine the two, and the learner can become the protagonist.

title: ODIN and BAANG for Safer, Greener Skies
content:
Every time an aircraft takes off, thousands of structural components must work perfectly under stress, vibration and changing temperatures. Ensuring that these structures remain safe for decades is one of the greatest challenges in aviation. The COST Action Optimising Design for Inspection (ODIN) decided to rethink this challenge from the very beginning.

Instead of asking how aircraft should be inspected after they are built, ODIN focused on embedding inspection into the design itself. The idea is similar to the human nervous system. Just as your body feels pain and reacts early, ODIN worked on aircraft structures that can ‘feel’ damage and report it before it becomes serious.

As Action Chair, Dr Rhys Pullin, from Cardiff University, explains:

“Much like the human body’s nervous system, these ‘built-in senses’ will provide real-time updates on the health and safety of the aircraft. They’ll also help the plane automatically adjust its shape to improve fuel efficiency, make the ride smoother, and ensure everything is running at its best.”

Planes are struck by lightning about once a year, but this is always safe

Jet speeds have not changed much in decades

title: A 30% cut to AgoraEU? Dubious savings with major consequences
content:
Culture Action Europe strongly opposes the cuts to AgoraEU set out in the Irish Presidency’s negotiating box for the EU’s 2028-2034 Multiannual Financial Framework (MFF), published on 10 October 2026.  

Under the proposal, funding for AgoraEU, the future EU programme for culture, media and democracy, would fall from the Commission’s €8.6 billion to €6 billion in current prices — a 30% cut.   

AgoraEU is among the hardest-hit programmes. The Irish Presidency also proposes -10% for Horizon Europe, -13% for the European Competitiveness Fund and -16% for the Global Europe Instrument, compared with the Commission’s allocation. 

All amounts are in € billion, in current prices, for 2028-2034. 

The disproportionate cuts are completely at odds with the commitments to support culture in the Joint Declaration ‘Europe for Culture – Culture for Europe’ that the Council co-signed in June 2026. 

It is especially disappointing to see this proposal coming under the Irish Presidency, a country known for its sustainable support for culture and its bold and successful Basic Income for the Arts scheme.

title: Indigenous Peoples' Day: Leonard Peltier on Resistance, New Film & Fighting for Freedom
content:
On Indigenous Peoples’ Day, we feature a conversation with one of the world’s most prominent champions for Indigenous rights, Leonard Peltier. “Indigenous Day is a day that’s been long overdue for any type of recognition,” says Peltier. “I am not going to give up, because we are not free yet. We are in danger. Trump and these organizations, they’re talking about doing away with our reservations and our treaties and everything else. … We’re going to stay here. You’re not going to get rid of us.”

Peltier is a longtime political prisoner who spent nearly half a century behind bars for a crime he says he did not commit — the 1975 fatal shooting of two FBI agents. In the final hours of his administration last year, President Biden commuted Peltier’s sentence, but his conviction has not been overturned, and he remains under home confinement on the Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa Reservation in Belcourt, North Dakota.

title: Britannia: Iran hieroi ilkeyksiä lentotukikohdallemme
content:
Iranin vallankumouskaarti oli lähes varmasti Fairfordin lentotukikohtaa uhanneen tihutyöjuonen takana, kertoi Britannian pääministeri Andy Burnham maanantaina.

Pääministerin kommenteista parlamentille kertoivat brittimediat Guardian ja BBC.

Fairfordin tukikohdan lähistöllä tapahtui syyskuun lopulla uhkatilanne. Naamioituneena liikkunut joukko oli puuhaillut ”jotain” tukikohta-alueen luona, ja paikallinen asukas ilmoitti heistä poliisille. Poliisi pidätti viisi paikallaolijaa – kaikki brittikansalaisia.

Viisikko vapautettiin tiukkoja ehtoja vastaan. Myös kaksi muuta pidätettiin ja vapautettiin myöhemmin. Syytteitä ei ole nostettu.

Britannian ulkoministeriö sanoi maanantaina, että Iranin suurlähettiläs oli kutsuttu puhutteluun.

PÄÄMINISTERI lupaa, että Britannia puuttuu nyt Iranin välikäsinään käyttämien rikollisverkostojen toimintaan.

Britit aikovat ottaa käyttöön uusia pakotteita, joilla rajoitetaan Iranin kykyä aiheuttaa haittaa Britannialle.

title: The Draft Notice: A Fake News Story That Resurfaces Every Year in Romania
content:
The image circulating online is fake. It claims to be a “Notice of Conscription” issued by the Ilfov County Military Centre, summoning a young man – apparently born after 2000, judging by the details visible on the document – to report on 20 October 2026 to complete the formalities for being “drafted into the Romanian Army”.

The Ministry of National Defence has stressed that the document is an attempt to mislead the public, with no legal basis and no connection to any actual developments.

The false claim has surfaced as the ministry is providing updates on MOBEX B-IF-26, an exercise to assess the mobilisation reserve currently taking place in Bucharest and Ilfov County.

“Mobile phone screens have recently been flooded with a purported Ministry of National Defence document claiming that a young man is being drafted into the army […] It is just another disinformation attempt,” acting Defence Minister Radu Miruță warned.

He urged the public to check information against official sources before sharing it.

title: Aineettomat investoinnit Suomessa ja Ruotsissa kysely- ja tilinpitopohjaisissa aineistoissa
content: Vertaamme aineettomien investointien rakennetta Suomessa ja Ruotsissa vuosina 2015–2021 kahdessa aineistossa: kansantalouden tilinpitoon ja sitä täydentäviin lähteisiin pohjautuvassa EU KLEMS & INTANProd -tietokannassa ja Euroopan investointipankin EIBIS-yrityskyselyssä. Aineettomien investointien erät, joilla on markkinatransaktio ja kirjanpitovastine – ohjelmistot ja data sekä Suomessa myös t&k – ovat lähteissä varsin yhdenmukaisia. Sen sijaan erät, jotka INTANProdissa johdetaan kustannusten summa -menetelmällä omasta työpanoksesta, poikkeavat voimakkaasti: organisaatiopääoman osuus on INTANProdissa lähes nelinkertainen kyselyyn verrattuna, ja koulutuksessa ero on päinvastainen. Aineettomien investointien osuudet ja maiden välisen vertailun tulokset riippuvat siten olennaisesti mittaustavasta. Havainnot saavat tukea Ranskaa ja Saksaa koskevista tuloksista (Nonnis, Roth & Bounfour, 2025a), joissa suurimmat lähteiden väliset ristiriidat paikantuvat samoihin kustannusten summa -menetelmällä johdettuihin eriin ja joissa organisaatiopääoman maittaiset erot palautuvat pitkälti johtaja-ammattien luokittelukäytäntöihin. Omat laskelmamme osoittavat, että johtajiksi luokiteltujen osuus on Ruotsissa noin kaksinkertainen Suomeen verrattuna, joten sama luokitteluherkkyys koskee myös Suomi–Ruotsi-vertailua.

title: Yhteinen työ alkaa toistemme tuntemisesta
content:
Millaisia vahvuuksia tuomme yhteiseen työskentelyyn? Miten opimme, käsittelemme tietoa ja olemme vuorovaikutuksessa? SYTY – Syvädiversiteetti työssä -hankkeen käynnistystapaamisessa Oulussa tutustuminen oli olennainen osa yhteisen työn suunnittelua.

eOppimiskeskuksen, TIEKEn ja Oulun ammattikorkeakoulun yhteinen hanke lähti liikkeelle oman työryhmän moninaisuuden ääreltä. Yhteisten tavoitteiden ja tekemisen suunnittelun rinnalla pysähdyimme siihen, millaisia ihmisiä hanketta on toteuttamassa.

Vapaamuotoinen keskustelu antoi tilaa tutustua tuleviin työkavereihin ja loi pohjaa yhteistyölle. Varsinaisena käynnistyspäivänä teimme näkyväksi omia vahvuuksiamme ja sitä, mitä kukin tuo yhteiseen työhön. Samalla opimme toistemme työskentely- ja vuorovaikutustahdista, tavoista sisäistää tietoa ja oppia sekä raotimme näkymää omiin arvoihimme.

Näissä keskusteluissa olimme hankkeen ytimessä. Syvädiversiteetti tarkoittaa ihmisten usein näkymättömäksi jäävää moninaisuutta: esimerkiksi erilaisia arvoja, ajattelutapoja, vahvuuksia ja tapoja oppia. Työyhteisössä nämä erot vaikuttavat siihen, miten työskentelemme ja ymmärrämme toisiamme.

PA Ship News

Coordination of the PA Ship is changing. Finnish Transport and Communications Agency will pass over the role of the Policy Area Coordination to Kotka Maritime Research Center Merikotka from 1st of January 2027 onwards. Coordinators from Traficom will pass over all material and knowledge forward to the coordinators at Merikotka. We wish all the best and smooth sails to the new coordinators!

SAVING THE SEA – News from our Projects

Circular Ports

Circular Ports has had an active start to autumn! The project has been represented at several events around the Baltic Sea Region, while work continues with all six pilots.

In August, Circular Ports took part in the Europe Forum in Turku with the Harbours of Change: Circular Economy in Baltic Sea Ports session, bringing together perspectives from EUSBSR PA Ship, Port of Turku and Circular Ports pilots on practical circular economy solutions in port environments. title: A wider European Union must also be a deeper one
content:
The EU needs a credible plan for governing an enlarged Union, not an assumption that its institutions will somehow adapt afterwards.

The European Union cannot afford to grow at the expense of its ability to act. Russia’s protracted war against Ukraine is the most visible sign of a more fragmented geopolitical landscape in which Moscow, as well as Beijing and Washington, increasingly exert pressure on European unity on enlargement. Meanwhile, regional powers like Turkey and some Gulf states further complicate relations in and with EU candidate countries. Enlargement is therefore not only about extending the EU’s borders; it is a test of strategic autonomy in deepening the Union. Admitting new members to bloated institutions, some of which are already vulnerable to national vetoes, risks turning a geopolitical necessity into a governance crisis.

title: What African elections can learn from the Borana Gadaa system
content:
Can the Borana Gadaa system inspire fairer elections, peaceful transitions, and stronger democracy across Africa?

Originally published on Global Voices

A Balli Walirafudhu handover ceremony held by the Borana Oromo people in Southern Ethiopia and northern Kenya. They have long practiced rotational, peaceful leadership transfer, known as the Borana Gadaa system. Photo used with permission.

This article by Diba Kosi Bilinga was originally published by Peace News Network on July 20, 2026. An edited version is being republished on Global Voices under a content partnership agreement.

Every election season, much of Africa braces itself. In some cases, incumbents amend constitutions to erase term limits, and citizens wait to see whether power will change hands at the ballot box or in the streets. The pattern repeats: disputed results, ethnic mobilization, coups, or leaders who refuse to leave.

Can the Borana Gadaa system inspire fairer elections, peaceful transitions, and stronger democracy across Africa?

title: People are asking AI who to vote for. We built a way for newsroom voter guides to answer
content:
Somewhere near you, a voter is opening their mail ballot for the Nov. 3 midterms. For many people, before filling in a single oval, their first move will be to snap a photo, paste it into their AI chatbot of choice and ask: Who should I vote for?

A local newsroom has spent months working to bring together the information to help voters answer that question. To build a voter guide, journalists ask every candidate the same set of questions, or put in the time to report on the positions of candidates who decline to participate. The AI chatbot might find that guide. It might not. Researchers testing AI chatbots this year found incomplete candidate lists and wrong or outdated voting information.

At Hacks/Hackers, we're launching the Voter Guide Commons to give AI a better place to look. It's a pilot that provides a shared server where newsrooms anywhere in the country can make their voter guides available to AI assistants through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

title: Escalating Armed Violence in Southeastern Iran: At Least 63 Armed Incidents in Six Months
content: HRANA – At least 63 armed incidents were recorded across Iran’s southeastern provinces of Sistan and Baluchestan and Kerman between March 31 and October 10, 2026, amid a sharp escalation in armed violence in the region. According to local and unofficial reports, the incidents left at least 94 people dead and 33 injured, while official sources reported 87 fatalities and 10 injuries. The pace of violence accelerated significantly in recent weeks, with 18 incidents recorded in just the final 18 days of the reporting period, surpassing the total for any previous full month. The escalation has also been accompanied by a shift in the nature of confrontations, from targeted shootings and attacks on patrol vehicles to coordinated ambushes, roadside bombings, and the reported use of rocket-propelled grenades and heavier weaponry.

title: Philippines: Flood Control Project Disregards Rights
content:
(Manila) – Philippine authorities disregarded the rights of residents who were removed from a small island in Pampanga province for a flood control project and relocated to a site with chronic flooding and few livelihood opportunities, Human Rights Watch said today. 

In 2022, the Macabebe, Pampanga government relocated 90 families without adequate consultation and information from Pulo Island on the Pampanga River. The relocation site, in the town of Macabebe, is a low-lying area that was formerly a fish pond that floods throughout the year, causing residents to struggle to access services and work. Although the Pulo community wanted to stay together, some family members have since left because of the effects of the flooding on their lives and livelihoods.

title: UN and The Hague Confront Impunity for War Crimes
content:
By Nicolas J. S. Davies

NEW YORK | 12 October 2026 (IDN) — On 9 October 2026, the Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to Navi Pillay, the South African international lawyer who defended Nelson Mandela and the anti-apartheid political prisoners on Robben Island, and went on to serve as a judge on the UN International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda and the International Criminal Court (ICC), and as UN High Commissioner for Human Rights. In 2025, Navi Pillay led the UN Commission of Inquiry that confirmed that Israel is committing genocide in Gaza.

With the world in the grip of seemingly intractable war and chaos, the Nobel Committee clearly wanted to honour someone who has worked against the tide of militarism and violence to uphold international law. Yet, on the same day, the United States unveiled unilateral, illegal coercive measures, or “sanctions”, against the ICC, where Navi Pillay served as a judge from 2003 to 2008.

The UN General Assembly’s 2026 general debate in September also set out to uphold the UN Charter and international law, and to confront the reality that the UN system is failing in its most basic responsibility, to maintain international peace and security.

title: The Freelancer Files: How to manage grant budgets
content:
A journalism grant can look straightforward on paper: money comes in, reporting gets done and expenses are paid. For freelancers working across borders, the reality can be much messier.

A grant may be taxed differently depending on where the recipient lives, how they are registered, and which part of the money pays for their own work. One person may receive funds for an entire team, then distribute them across several countries. Invoicing requirements, sales tax rules and reporting obligations can all vary.

That was the starting point for “The Freelancer Files”, a hands-on workshop led by Cora María Moyano Reymundo, finance manager at Arena for Journalism in Europe, at IJ4EU’s recent UNCOVERED Conference in Budapest.

Moyano organised the workshop to help freelancers navigate this thicket of financial and administrative requirements alongside their reporting.

The bad news first: there is no universal fix. The good news is that some simple habits can help prevent costly surprises.

“I don’t have the tax advice of your life,” Moyano told participants. “And we’ll try to sort it together, because there is nothing in one country that is exactly the same in the next.”

title: Entretien avec Eleonora Alariesto – DJ Hulluella
content:
Avant même que l’entretien ne commence, une question se pose déjà : est-ce que je parle à Eleonora Alariesto ou à DJ Hulluella ?

Vêtue d’une tenue qui associe des éléments du costume sámi traditionnel, le gákti, des bijoux en argent faits main et des couleurs symbolisant ses liens familiaux dans la région sámi du Nord, elle l’a complétée par des collants en résille, des grosses bottes en cuir et une casquette en jean décorée de faux diamants.

Ce mélange esthétique reflète également la diversité d’Eleonora Alariesto et de l’univers artistique de son alter ego créatif, DJ Hulluella. Il apparaît rapidement que les deux existent simultanément, mais dans des rôles différents.

Eleonora Alariesto est journaliste indépendante, animatrice du podcast « Mii gullo… ? » et productrice, la plupart de ses projets actuels étant liés d’une manière ou d’une autre à la culture sámi.

title: The People, Counted: Browse Raw Census Records at the Internet Archive
content:
The U.S. Census has been in the headlines lately, as proposed changes to the 2030 count have sparked debate over who gets counted and what information should be recorded as part of that process. Few government records say more about a democracy than the census, the once-a-decade count that decides who is represented in Congress, which makes it a natural fit for Democracy’s Library, the Internet Archive’s effort to make government information freely available to everyone. Thanks to the Allen County Public Library, the Internet Archive holds the U.S. Census collection. This collection contains digitized microfilm of the United States federal population census, 1790 to 1930 (minus the lost 1890 Census), and including the Indian Census rolls of 1885 to 1940, which were compiled by the Bureau of Indian Affairs.

The United States Census is one of the few institutional structures that was written into the Constitution, with Article I, Section 2 specifying that an “actual Enumeration” would be made every ten years in order to divide seats in the House of Representatives and direct taxes among the states.

title: Workshop med idégenerering på Kalmar läns museum
content:
Det är en mulen septembermorgon i Kalmar, när personalen samlas för gemensamt fika, följt av en halv dags workshop ledd av Riksantikvarieämbetet. Utställningsmediet är ett dynamiskt sådant, där nya lösningar och infallsvinklar ständigt efterfrågas. Syftet med workshopen är att praktiskt hjälpa Kalmar läns museum till nya sätt att tänka på sin publik och sina målgrupper, och utveckla sina erbjudanden och utställningar.

Vi kommer snabbt igång med workshopens första övning. Indelade i grupper, får deltagarna till att börja med fyra minuter på sig att skriva ner så många möjliga och omöjliga användningsområden de kan komma på för en klädnypa. I nästa steg halveras tiden till två minuter, och deltagarna ska komma på dubbelt så många nya användningsområden för klädnypan som de gjorde på de fyra minuterna.

Det handlar om idégenerering; om att förutsättningslöst och utan hänsyn till vad som borde vara möjligt eller inte, tänka i nya banor kring det invanda och förmodat självklara. Samtalen kommer igång, och det att ingenting behöver ”vara på riktigt” sätter den lekfullt kreativa tonen för resten av workshopen.

content:

Robot Framework on avoimen lähdekoodin automaatiojärjestelmä, jota käytetään ohjelmistojen testiautomaatioon ja prosessien automatisointiin. Se syntyi Pekka Klärckin Teknillisen korkeakoulun diplomityöstä vuonna 2005, ja siitä on sittemmin kasvanut maailmanlaajuinen menestystarina. title: Ny skiva med flöjtensemblen Tuultenpesä förenar musik, minnen och kulturarv
content:
Hemvist är den finsk-svenska flöjtsextetten Tuultenpesäs andra album. Skivans tema kretsar kring frågor om tillhörighet, migration, minne och identitet. Skivan ges ut i samarbete med Finlands svenska folkmusikinstitut.

Tuultenpesäs karakteristiska ljudvärld formas av ett rikt urval flöjter från olika tider och traditioner. Åspipor, Härjedalspipor, Månmarkapipor, honkahuilu-flöjter, blockflöjter och tvärflöjter möter Leena Laitinens sång i musik som rör sig mellan stillhet och rytmisk energi, mellan enkelhet och flerstämmiga klanglandskap.

Materialet på skivan bygger på äldre uppteckningar och arkivinspelningar av finlandssvensk folkmusik. Traditionella melodier och visor från bland annat Oravais, Purmo, Petalax, Korsnäs, Sibbo, Borgå och Mörskom vävs samman med svensk folkmusik och ensemblemedlemmarnas egna kompositioner.

Tuultenpesä grundades 2016 och består av Kristiina Ilmonen, Mimmi Laaksonen, Leena Laitinen, Göran Månsson, Kirsi Ojala och Jonas Simonson. Debutalbumet Vindstilla utkom 2022.

Hemvist publiceras digitalt på bland annat Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, YouTube Music, Deezer och Pandora samt ges ut på cd.

title: Perulainen muotisuunnittelija Sadith Silvano maalaa tekstiilejä kansansa ayahuasca-kuvioin
content:
Miksi aamupala on niin surkea? Se oli Sadith Silvanon ensimmäinen ajatus, kun hän saapui lapsena Amazonian sademetsäalueelta Perun pääkaupunkiin Limaan. Aamiainen oli vetistä kaura­litkua ja pikakahvia, joskus lisukkeena säälittävä sämpylä.

Kotona Amazoniassa oli syöty täyttäviä hedelmiä ja jos ei muuta ollut, joku perheenjäsen lähti kalaan. Talot olivat suuria, ovi oli aina auki – ja ilma puhdasta.

Silvanot saapuivat Liman Cantagallon asuinalueelle 2000-luvun alussa yhdessä 50 muun shipibo-konibo-­alku­peräis­kansaan kuuluvan perheen kanssa. Isä oli perustellut kaupunkiin lähtöä: Limassa olisi mahdollisuuksia ja lapsille koulutusta.

Tulijat käyttivät ajalle tyypillistä vyörytysstrategiaa, jossa kukin perhe valitsi oman maatilkkunsa ja rakensi vaatimattoman kotinsa vanerista. Sitten perheet järjestäytyivät perustamalla asukasyhdistyksen, joka vaati kaupungilta kiinteistön omistusoikeutta ja peruspalveluita.

Ajan myötä vastahakoinen kaupunginhallinto myöntyi, tiet päällystettiin ja vesijohdot vedettiin. Asuntojen laatua kohennettiin.

”Ensin elimme luonnon antimilla ja puhuimme omaa kieltämme. Kohtasimme jyrkän sosiaalisen kuilun. Siinä ei ollut mitään kaunista.”

title: EU Blacklists Nearly 1,600 in Russian Defense Firms and Executives
content:
The European Union adopted its largest-ever single set of sanctions against Russia to date on Monday, blacklisting 1,569 individuals and companies within the country's military-industrial complex.

The measures blacklist 826 Russian companies and 743 chief executives, bringing the total number of listings under the EU sanctions regime protecting Ukraine’s territorial integrity to nearly 4,600. The designated entities face immediate asset freezes and funding blocks, while the targeted individuals are now barred from entering the bloc.

The package specifically targets mid-level suppliers that form the "core" of Russia's defense sector, which together generate an annual turnover of at least 20 billion euros ($22.32 billion) and employ more than 250,000 people.

According to the European Council, the designated companies supply critical components for advanced weapons systems, including semiconductors, radars, satellite systems, explosives, and optics. Notably, more than half of the new listings address the production chain for the ballistic missiles Russia uses in its daily strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure.

title: The Biggest Ship in History Was Built in China 600 Years Ago—Or Was It?
content: In 2002, the retired British submarine lieutenant-commander turned amateur historian Gavin Menzies created a stir with a book about Chinese seafaring in the fifteenth century. 1421: The Year China Discovered the World (tellingly titled 1421: The Year China Discovered America in the United States) began as a global history of that year, only coming to focus on the claim of the title through the interventions of publishing-industry professionals. They no doubt sensed a lucrative controversy in the offing, and events proved them right. Not only did the book turn bestseller, it also managed the rare feat of drawing, among other responses, a two-hour PBS documentary dedicated to debunking it. Today, 1421 is most charitably remembered as a work of historical fiction written around the idea that, even if China didn’t actually discover the world, wouldn’t it be neat if it had?

title: Document: Germany, Italy request ‘emergency brake’ power to stop new EU laws
content:
EU capitals must be able to intervene to stop new legislation from Brussels if they say it’s too burdensome for governments and businesses, the leaders of Germany, Italy and Belgium wrote on Monday.

In a letter addressed to European Council President António Costa and obtained by POLITICO, the three leaders said the bloc needs an “emergency brake” mechanism to help boost its flagging economic competitiveness.

German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni and Belgian Prime Minister Bart de Wever also called to “significantly accelerate planning and approval procedures,” suspend “certain regulatory areas for a specified period” under a new “priority rule.”

“We call for further ambitious simplification packages to decisively advance the cutting of red tape in the European Union,” they wrote, adding that the Commission must ease the burden “first and foremost” on small and medium-sized businesses.

“More broadly,” the letter reads, “our common objective should be to prevent unnecessary regulatory burdens and related costs from causing permanent losses of European industrial capacity and further weakening investment and competitiveness.”

title: Possessed nuns and sexual deviance: the history behind Ken Russell’s highly-censored film The Devils
content:
The long-awaited director’s cut of the late Ken Russell’s 1971 film The Devils will be released this month, featuring previously unseen censored material such as the notorious “rape of Christ” sequence.

The film is a dramatisation of the supposed demonic possessions of a convent of nuns that unfolded in 17th century Loudon, in western France.

It focuses on the religious fanaticism that consumed the town, and the tragic figure at the centre of it – Urbain Grandier – the Catholic priest who was ultimately charged with witchcraft and burned at the stake.

At the heart of The Devils is a powerful critique of institutional religion and its union with the state, scapegoating and violent oppression.

Upon its release, The Devils was banned in several countries and heavily censored in others.

The film is full of wild imagery of spiritual ecstasies, torture, violence and sexual impurities. The most egregious examples of this imagery had to be cut before the United Kingdom and United States film boards would even classify the film.

Cuts ranged from minor close-ups of graphic torture and nudity, to a brief scene of a nun pleasuring herself with a charred human femur bone.

title: Kuntien koulurahat uusiksi: Kasvun pitää kannattaa
content:
Peruskoulu maksaa Utsjoella yli 48 000 euroa oppilasta kohden vuodessa, kun taas Muuramessa ja Tyrnävällä noin 9 000 euroa. Helsingin Sanomien (11.10.2026) laskelmat näyttävät mustana valkoisella sen, minkä moni kuntapäättäjä tietää. Lisäksi valtiovarainministeriön osastopäällikkö Jussi Virsunen totesi jutussa, että osa kunnista ei enää ole elinkelpoisia. Hän ei tarkoittanut, ettei näillä alueilla voisi elää, vaan että kunnan tulot eivät enää riitä sen menoihin ja palveluihin.

Tämä pitää ottaa vakavasti. Valtion rahaa ei pidä käyttää epäterveen rakenteen ylläpitoon, vaan se pitää kohdentaa sinne, missä lasten palveluita eniten tarvitaan.

Kunnan rahat tulevat pääosin kahdesta lähteestä: asukkaiden maksamasta kunnallisverosta ja valtionosuuksista. Valtionosuus lasketaan kaavalla, jossa painavat esimerkiksi asukkaiden ikärakenne ja välimatkat. Kunta saa käyttää rahan vapaasti. Lisäksi järjestelmä tasaa kuntien verotuloja: osa vahvan veropohjan kuntien verotuloista ohjataan kunnille, joiden asukkaat ansaitsevat keskimääräistä vähemmän.

Valtio siis maksaa kunnalle könttäsumman, mutta ei juurikaan ohjaa sitä, mihin raha päätyy.

title: Who’s who in the Zoo – Tom Donlon
content:
Meet Tom Donlon, a postdoctoral researcher at the University of Minnesota, who studies the Milky Way’s structure, evolution, and what it can tell us about dark matter. Tom shares why our Galaxy is wrinkly, what makes citizen science communities so powerful, and how Zooniverse volunteers are helping build a first-of-its-kind catalogue of shell galaxies.

Name: Tom Donlon (Postdoctoral Researcher)

Location: University of Minnesota Twin Cities

Zooniverse projects: Galaxy Zoo: What the Shell?, Artifact InSPECtor, Clump Scout II

What is your research about?

My work mainly involves understanding the structure of the Milky Way, the galaxy where we live. I’m interested in how it grows, changes, and evolves, with the ultimate goal of learning whatever we can about the dark matter inside our Galaxy. This has led me to think about a pretty broad range of objects — old stars, pulsars, variable stars — and how we can use them in creative and interesting ways to learn about the makeup of the Milky Way. I’ve also spent time working on the chemical composition of our Galaxy, its dynamic structure like waves and wiggles, and shell galaxies.

How do Zooniverse volunteers contribute to your research?

title: 40C3 – Azubitag
content:
Mit dem Congress bietet der CCC einen Raum, über vielfältige Themen zu lernen, sich mit Interessierten auszutauschen und vieles Neues kennenzulernen.

Um für Berufseinsteiger*innen einen leichten Zugang in unsere Community zu ermöglichen, haben wir vor vier Jahren den Azubitag ins Leben gerufen.

Die Idee:
Ein Tag, an dem Azubis aller Berufe den Congress mit einem reduzierten Tagesticket erkunden dürfen.

Dieses Konzept hat in den letzten Jahren sehr gut funktioniert. Deshalb können wir jetzt mit großer Freude ankündigen, dass es auch beim 40C3 einen Azubitag geben wird. Er wird wieder am Congress-Tag 3 stattfinden, dem 29.12.2026. Es wird eine Startveranstaltung und ein kleines Sonderprogramm für den Azubitag geben. Die vielen Vorträge im allgemeinen Programm des Congress und alle Stände und Assemblies sind natürlich ebenfalls offen für euch. Eingeladen sind Auszubildende aller Berufe, die den Congress und den CCC kennenlernen möchten.

title: AI Company Lets Cops Pinpoint Specific Houses Based on a Single Interior Photo
content:
An AI company now lets cops take a photo and nearly instantly figure out what specific home it was taken in, using only clues in the photo itself, and is clearly pulling data from sites like Zillow and Airbnb. 

The tool, called Raven, shows the increasing power of AI capabilities available to local law enforcement agencies. 404 Media previously reported that both the Los Angeles Police Department and Miami-Dade Sheriff’s Office (MDSO) have bought access to Raven, which was previously called GeoSpy. Now, Raven, made by a company called Graylark Technologies, has added features that let cops analyze the interior of homes.

In a post on LinkedIn earlier this month, Graylark CEO Daniel Heinen wrote the company was introducing “the ability to geolocate interior images across millions of short-term rental units worldwide.” An accompanying demo video shows someone taking a photo from X of a washer/dryer unit inside a building. They upload it to Raven, select “Find Property: Interior and exterior property geolocation,” and then choose a region to search.
snippet: An AI company now lets cops take a photo and nearly instantly figure out what specific home it was taken in, using only clues in the photo itself, and is clearly pulling data from sites like Zillow

title: Protesters Say India's Democracy Is "Rotten" as Modi Gov't Purges Voter Rolls, Arrests Thousands
content:
Tens of thousands of people in India have taken to the streets in recent days to protest the deletion of 130 million names from the voter rolls, a large majority of which are believed to be opposed to Narendra Modi’s ruling BJP party. The demonstrations, joined by leaders from India’s opposition parties, are being led by students and the youth-led “Cockroach” movement. Tens of thousands of security forces, including paramilitary and police, were out on the streets over the weekend cracking down on the uprising, detaining protesters en masse, including lawyers, journalists and protest leaders.

The demonstrations “represent an outpouring of anger, of frustration at what many Indians feel is the fact that their democracy has been taken away,” says Shoaib Daniyal, political editor of Scroll, who was arrested on Saturday along with 7,000 other protesters. He points out that “the deletions have affected Muslims far more than they have affected other Indians.”

title: Ülle Madise vannoi virkavalansa Virossa – saapuu Suomeen keskiviikkona
content:
Viron presidentti Ülle Madise on vannonut virkavalansa. Hänet valittiin presidentiksi syyskuussa.

Maan parlamentin riigikogun 101 jäsenestä 71 äänesti hänen valintansa puolesta.

Presidentillä on Virossa vähemmän valtaa kuin Suomessa. Valtionpäämiehenä hänen tärkein tehtävänsä on edustaa Viroa kansainvälisissä suhteissa.

title: An AI bot for polishing Malayalam Wikipedia articles
content:
In a Malayalam Wikipedia article about cricket, Everton Weekes was not a man. He was ആഴ്ചകൾ (aazhchakal), the Malayalam word for “weeks”. His surname was machine-translated. In a physics article, a textbook was credited to an author named പുൽത്തകിടി (pulthakidi), “lawn”; the author’s surname was Lawn.

Errors like these sat on their pages for years, unnoticed, because the Malayalam reads perfectly like Malayalam. Thousands of our articles were translated from other languages, and many are still waiting for a second pass. Our community simply has too few editors to clean up the kind of mess that translation sometimes leaves behind. That is what led me to look for a solution involving AI, and to build a bot called AksharaBot, named from the Malayalam word അക്ഷരം (aksharam), meaning “letter”.

In August 2026, I proposed this AI-powered bot for Malayalam Wikipedia. To be fully transparent about how it works, I put its most awkward quality at the center of the request for the community to judge:

title: Bangladesh-Malaysia recruitment reforms revive old questions over the cost of migration
content:
Repeated disruptions raise concerns over recruitment transparency and migrant workers’ protection from exploitation.

Originally published on Global Voices

On Saturday, October 5, 2024, a Memorandum of Collaboration (MOC) was signed in Dhaka between the Wage Earners Welfare Board and Malaysia's PERKESO, regarding the expansion of the labor market in Malaysia. Image via Wikipedia by Press Information Department of Bangladesh. Public Domain.

Officials in both Bangladesh and Malaysia’s have made repeated attempts to reform the countries’ labour migration relationship, leading to numerous suspensions and reopenings over more than three decades.

However, on August 30, 2026, Bangladesh’s State Minister for Local Government, Rural Development and Cooperatives, Mir Shahe Alam, announced that Malaysia would recruit around 200,000 Bangladeshi workers over six months, with departures expected to begin in late September. He also referred to a plan to send 10,000 workers without requiring them to bear migration costs.

title: Two Prisoners Executed in Kerman Prison on Drug-Related Charges
content:
According to HRANA, citing Haal Vsh, a prisoner was executed at dawn on Monday, October 12, 2026, in Kerman Prison. He has been identified as Amin Khajeh-Nezami, 33, son of Mehdi, the father of three children, from Rigan County.

According to the report, Mr. Khajeh-Nezami was arrested in Kerman in 2022 on drug-related charges and subsequently sentenced to death by the Revolutionary Court of Kerman.

The Balochistan Human Rights Documentation Network identified the second prisoner as Habibollah Ghanbarzehi Farjad, 38, a married father from Zahedan.

According to the report, Mr. Ghanbarzahi Farjad was arrested in Kerman in November 2023 on drug-related charges and subsequently sentenced to death by judicial authorities. He worked as a driver and had denied the charges against him.

His family visited Kerman Prison on the evening of yesterday, for a final meeting with him. Mai Sato, the United Nations Special Rapporteur on the situation of human rights in Iran, had previously expressed concern over the possibility of Habibollah Ghanbarzehi Farjad’s execution.

At the time of this report, the executions had not been officially announced by prison authorities or other relevant institutions.

title: Interview with Eleonora Alariesto – DJ Hulluella
content:
Before the interview begins, one question is already present: am I talking to Eleonora Alariesto or DJ Hulluella?

Dressed in an outfit that combines elements of traditional Sámi dress, gákti, handcrafted silver jewellery and colours symbolising her family ties in the Northern Sámi region, she has paired it with fishnet stockings, chunky leather boots and a denim cap decorated with fake diamonds.

The aesthetic mixture also reflects the diversity of both Eleonora Alariesto and the artistic universe of her creative alter ego, DJ Hulluella. It quickly becomes clear that the two exist at the same time, but in different roles.

Eleonora Alariesto is a freelance journalist, host of the podcast “Mii gullo…?” and producer, with most of her current projects connected in some way to Sámi culture.

title: Huiluyhtye Tuultenpesän uusi levy yhdistää musiikin, muistot ja kulttuuriperinnön
content:
Hemvist on suomalais-ruotsalaisen huilusekstetti Tuultenpesän toinen albumi. Levyn teemat liittyvät yhteenkuulumiseen, muuttoliikkeeseen, muistiin ja identiteettiin. Albumi julkaistaan yhteistyössä Finlands svenska folkmusikinstitutin kanssa.

Tuultenpesän omaleimainen äänimaailma rakentuu eri aikakausia ja erilaisia perinteitä edustavista huiluista. Åspipa, härjedalspipa, månmarkanpipa, honkahuilut, nokkahuilut ja poikkihuilut kohtaavat Leena Laitisen laulun musiikissa, joka liikkuu hiljaisuuden ja rytmisen energian sekä yksinkertaisuuden ja moniäänisten äänimaisemien välillä.

Levyllä kuultava musiikki perustuu vanhoihin muistiinpanoihin ja arkistoäänitteisiin, joille on tallennettu suomenruotsalaista kansanmusiikkia. Muun muassa Oravaisilla, Purmossa, Petolahdella, Korsnäsissä, Sipoossa, Porvoossa ja Myrskylässä tallennetut perinteiset sävelmät ja laulut kietoutuvat yhteen ruotsalaisen kansanmusiikin sekä yhtyeen jäsenten omien sävellysten kanssa.

Tuultenpesä on perustettu vuonna 2016. Yhtyeeseen kuuluvat Kristiina Ilmonen, Mimmi Laaksonen, Leena Laitinen, Göran Månsson, Kirsi Ojala ja Jonas Simonson. Tuultenpesän esikoisalbumi Vindstilla julkaistiin vuonna 2022.

title: Croatia Expands Probe Into Alleged Multi-Million-Euro Toxic Waste Scheme
content:
Croatia's anti-corruption office, USKOK, expanded its investigation into an alleged international illegal waste dumping ring, arresting and questioning five new suspects and three companies over the suspected criminal disposal of hazardous materials near the town of Benkovac and inside the Velebit Nature Park near Senj.

The suspects were released after questioning, as USKOK stated there were no legal grounds to request pre-trial detention. Friday's action marks the third expansion of the sweeping environmental crime probe, which now targets a total of 14 individuals and four companies suspected of severe environmental crimes and falsifying official documents within a criminal enterprise.

The investigation, supported by Europol and law enforcement from Italy and Slovenia, became public in February 2025 with the initial arrest of 13 people. Authorities dismantled an alleged criminal network that is accused of orchestrating the illegal import of hazardous waste from Germany, Italy, and Slovenia into Croatia.

title: A 900-Page Pre-Pantone Guide to Color from 1692: A Complete High-Resolution Digital Scan
content:
There’s ahead of its time, then there’s Traité des couleurs servant à la peinture à l’eau — or, in its original Dutch title, Klaer Lightende Spiegel der Verfkonst, a 900-page book of paint colors made before any such things were common tools of the artist’s, scientist’s, and industrial designer’s trade. Author and artist A. Boogert created one, and only one, copy of his extraordinary manual on color mixing in 1692. Appearing on the threshold of modern color theory, and featuring over 700 pages of color swatches, the book draws on Aristotle’s system of color rather than the new understanding of the color spectrum, fully elaborated by Newton in his Opticks over a decade later.

It would be another hundred years before a flood tide of color books began to make the theory more practical: from Goethe’s 1810 Theory of Colors and Werner’s 1814 Nomenclature of Colour to the dream of color standardization realized: the Pantone company, launched in 1963.

title: Von der Leyen pitches AI as solution to reduce reporting for European businesses
content:
European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen on Monday pitched using artificial intelligence to streamline administrative procedures for European businesses as part of a broader push to simplify commerce and boost the EU’s competitiveness.

Speaking at a behind-closed-doors meeting of the European People’s Party in Taormina, Sicily, on Oct. 12, von der Leyen said the Commission would introduce an “only once” approach to business reporting. This would let companies submit information once, with AI helping public administrations use the data.

Von der Leyen argued that European companies repeatedly have to report the same information to public authorities, wasting time that businesses — and Europe — cannot afford, according to a copy of her speech seen by POLITICO.

“And this is why we will introduce ‘Only Once’, to report data only once – and with the help of AI the administration will ensure efficient use,” she said.

The speech marks the first time von der Leyen has explicitly pitched using AI specifically to reduce businesses’ administrative workload.

title: Hooked on tuna: People have been harvesting these ocean predators for 44,000 years
content:
From a humble mayonnaise-laden sandwich to an expensive piece of sashimi, tuna is a prized source of food for people around the world. Once an inexpensive, easily shipped canned protein source, today’s bluefin tunas can fetch millions of dollars at auction. Millions of tons of tuna are harvested every year, supporting a global industry worth around US$40 billion annually.

But tunas are more than just the pink flesh found in cans and sushi, and humanity’s story with these fish goes back further than you might expect.

As a biologist and an archaeologist interested in long-term human-environment interactions, we wanted to investigate the deep record of people’s relationship with tunas.

title: Miksen ole vasemmistolainen?
content:
Oikeisto tekee nykyään kaikkensa, jotta minusta tulisi vasemmistolainen. Vasemmisto esittää usein hyviä tavoitteita, kun taas nykyoikeiston ajatuksia on välillä vaikea erottaa huonosta vitsistä. Mutta yritys ei onnistu. Olen edelleen ääriprogressiivinen sentristi.

Miksen sitten ole vasemmistolainen, vaikka jaan ison osan sen tavoitteista? Koska haluan, että ne toteutuvat. 

Minulla on maailmanparannukselle kaksi ehtoa: ratkaisuille pitää saada demokraattinen kannatus, ja niiden pitää toimia.

Jos ratkaisu edellyttää vasemmiston maailmanlaajuista vaalivoittoa, maailma jää pelastamatta.

Ilmastonmuutos ja luontokato eivät odota, että ihmiskunta omaksuu yhteisen maailmankuvan. Ratkaisujen pitää kelvata myös oikeistolaisille. Ei siksi, että he olisivat erityisen tärkeitä, vaan siksi, että heitäkin on olemassa.

Ei maailmaa pelasteta neljän vuoden aikana silloin tällöin. Pitää löytää ylipolitisoituneen pingpongin ja toistuvien vastareaktioiden sijaan malleja, jotka pysyvät vuosikymmeniä käytäntöinä.

title: Ammattiliitot vaativat vuosilomalakia remonttiin – toisi viikon lisää lomaa
content:
Insinööriliitto ja Tradenomit ehdottavat, että vuosilomalakia uudistettaisiin siten, ettei lauantai kuluttaisi enää lomapäiviä. Lisäksi vuosilomaa pitäisi liittojen mielestä kertyä 2,5 päivää työsuhteen alusta alkaen.

Ammattiliitot muistuttavat, että työviikko on ollut viisipäiväinen jo 1960-luvulta lähtien. Lauantai lasketaan silti yhä työpäiväksi, vaikkei työntekijä työskentelisi lauantaisin. Tämä kuluttaa vuosilomaa yksityisellä sektorilla.

– Vuosilomalaki on jämähtänyt vuosikymmenten taakse ja sen joustamattomuus ei palvele ketään. Vuosilomalain uudistaminen olisi iso askel niin työhyvinvoinnin ja tuottavuuden parantamiseen kuin perheiden hyvinvoinnin tukemiseen, Insinööriliiton puheenjohtaja Samu Salo sanoo tiedotteessa.

– Lauantailaskennasta luopuminen toisi työntekijöille viikon lisää lomaa, joka olisi merkittävä investointi työntekijöiden työhyvinvointiin, vähentäisi kalliita sairauspoissaoloja ja nostaisi sitä kautta tuottavuutta, Tradenomien edunvalvontajohtaja Ville-Veikko Rantamaula sanoo.

title: The Story of WikiTour: How It Started, What We Learned, and Where We Hope to Go
content:
From our point of view, as Kent Wiki Club alumni (Jjurieee and Blusjai)

Every language carries stories. It carries the names of places, the wisdom of elders, the stories passed from one generation to another, and the ways communities understand the world around them. Yet, when we look at the digital world, many of these languages remain largely invisible.

For us, WikiTour began with a simple question:

What if our students could become the people who put their own languages on the map of the internet?

The journey began in 2024, when Kent Wikimedia Club, Kent Campus Institute of Teacher Education, Tuaran, Sabah together with Wikimedia Community User Group Malaysia (WCUGM), held the first WikiTour at three locations: Universiti Pendidikan Sultan Idris (UPSI), Sarawak State Education Department, and Sandakan National Secondary School.

title: Omar Dorostaran Executed
content:
According to HRANA, citing Mizan News Agency, Omar Dorostaran has been executed.

The report did not specify the charges against Dorostaran but stated that he had been sentenced to death by the judiciary, that the verdict had been upheld by the Supreme Court, and that the sentence had been carried out.

The Judiciary’s Media Center claimed that Dorostaran was an active member of Jaish al-Adl and had played a key role in several of the group’s operations, including attacks on the Rask police headquarters, the IRGC headquarters in Rask, the Parud base, and military facilities in Chabahar in April 2024.

According to the news agency’s allegations, Dorostaran’s activities included arranging accommodation for group members, facilitating their entry into Iran, transporting operational teams to carry out armed attacks, procuring weapons and ammunition, and identifying military facilities as potential targets.

The report did not specify the exact date of the execution or the prison where the sentence was carried out.

title: Senegal: Brutal Crackdown Violates LGBT People’s Rights
content:
(Dakar) Senegal’s growing crackdown on Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, and Transgender (LGBT) people is violating their rights, causing increasing fear and stigma, and should be ended immediately, Human Rights Watch said today. Mass arrests forced HIV testing and barriers to legal representation appear to be part of an increase in punitive government action against LGBT people in West Africa.

On March 11, 2026, Senegal’s parliament amended article 319 of the penal code, doubling to 10 years the maximum prison term for consensual same-sex conduct and criminalizing “promotion” of or support to LGBT people and organizations. The amendment followed the detention by security forces of at least five men in Thiès region in December 2025 and 12 men in the capital, Dakar, in February 2026 on charges including “acts against nature” and “intentional transmission of HIV.” Police and gendarmerie then escalated arrests of suspected LGBT people in various other cities including Thiès, Rosso, Saint Louis, Yeumbeul, and Ziguinchor.

title: EEPA reports on ENDF capture key towns near Eritrean border
content:
• Ethiopia National Defence Forces (ENDF) and Tigray Peace Forces (TPF) entered Adwa on 11 October. 
  • The Bure, Denakil, Garbo and Awala areas in the Afar region are now considered active combat zones between Ethiopian and Eritrean forces. These clashes involve infantry, heavy weapons and aircrafts. 
  • ENDF and TPF troops are moving closer to the Eritrean border, having captured the towns of Adi Hayelom, Seyemti Adiyabo and Adi Nebrid.
  • Eritrean forces withdrew from Adigrat on 7 October, with ENDF drone strikes targeting withdrawing vehicles. The ENDF and TPF took control of Adigrat between 9 and 10 October.
  • ENDF forces took control of Shire town, northwest Tigray, and of Atsibi and Freweyni, eastern Tigray, on 9 October. 
  • ENDF took control of Idaga Hamus town, Hawzen town and Abiy Adi, northern Tigray, on 9 October. 
  • TPF is allegedly seizing people’s vehicles by force, according to a source in Mekelle. 
  • ENDF fighters are entering and occupying school buildings in Wukro, Tigray, according to a resident on 11 October. 
  • Schools in Egela and Ahza in Tigray were hit and destroyed by drone strikes on 11 October. The responsible party has not yet been identified.

title: Entretien avec les artistes de Correspondance sous terre
content:
L’Institut finlandais et Ehkä Production ont invité l’artiste française Tilhenn Klapper et les artistes finlandaises Anna Torkkel et Ella Skoikka à participer à une correspondance créative de huit semaines au printemps 2025, alors que la nature commençait à fleurir et à germer. Le projet a été facilité et conceptualisé par l’artiste Saija Kangasniemi, productrice à l’Institut finlandais ce printemps.

À travers l’écriture d’un journal intime collectif, les artistes ont partagé leurs paysages intérieurs grâce à des écrits intuitifs quotidiens sur la vie ordinaire, extraordinaire et sur les choses souvent invisibles, ainsi que sur leurs pratiques artistiques liées à la danse et au son. L’artiste française Lia Pradal (Editions Païen) a conçu le livret imprimé du journal et réalisé les visuels du projet.

title: A Chinese Auto Giant Sponsors Portugal's National Football Team. Its Trucks Are Used by Russia to Attack Ukraine.
content:
As part of its “Vast Ocean Plan” for global expansion, one of China’s largest automotive companies recently announced its sponsorship of Portugal’s national football team.  

“Europe stands as a strategic priority,” Changan Automobile said in a press release in May, adding that its partnership with the Portuguese Football Federation offered a new opportunity for “brand engagement across the region.”

In an earlier phase of a global push by the state-owned company, Changan moved into Russia. Later, as international car makers left following Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, Changan started exporting more vehicles to fill the gap in the market, according to the industry analysis group inovev. 

Reporters found that some of those vehicles have been used in Russia's war against Ukraine, as launchpads for models of drones known to have attacked both military targets and civilians.

Changan Automobile did not respond to requests for comment. 

The Portugal Football Federation said the contract with Changan was signed after being reviewed for “the tight Federation compliance rules.”

title: How can Europe leverage laws to secure cloud sovereignty?
content:
European organizations have to reckon with how to keep up with the modern world without sacrificing sovereignty. Geopolitical instability, tightening regulatory expectations and the rapid adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) mean that, for many organizations, sovereignty now sits alongside resilience and business continuity in board-level risk discussions. The question they can no longer defer is how to harness the opportunities of the modern cloud without surrendering control over their own data. Answering it requires honesty about what sovereignty means, and about where it can actually be found.

title: 300 glaciers have disappeared from the American West since the mid-20th century – the survivors have a few things in common
content:
From an airplane, most of the glaciers of the Rocky Mountain West look like small patches of white nestled into rugged landscape where the topography folds. The white is the snow cover, and lower down you can see the gray-blue bare ice.

In the middle of the 20th century, over 1,450 glaciers could be found in the contiguous U.S. Together, they covered 217 square miles (562 square kilometers) in six western states. Today, a comprehensive review my colleagues and I just published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences shows their total area has shrunk by 35% and they are still shrinking, perhaps faster.

A little more than 300 glaciers have disappeared, way more than I had anticipated.

Those that survive reflect just how vulnerable mountain glaciers have become as global temperatures rise. Where glaciers once covered large expanses of the western mountains thousands of years ago, most of the remaining glaciers in the Rockies and Sierra Nevada are small and found in topographically protected places.

title: Satavuotias arvotalo otti hukkalämmön hyötykäyttöön – lämmityskustannuksiin odotetaan 37 prosentin säästöä
content:
Helsingin Kalliossa, osoitteessa Suonionkatu 7, sijaitsevan arvokiinteistön lämmönjakohuoneessa kohtaavat historia ja tulevaisuus. Siellä, missä aikoinaan poltettiin hiiltä ja koksia, toimivat nykyään lämpöpumput, älykäs rakennusautomaatio ja poistoilman lämmöntalteenottojärjestelmä.

Arkkitehti Kaarlo Borgin suunnittelema, vuonna 1926 valmistunut rakennus on asemakaavalla suojeltu. Kiinteistöön kuuluu 64 asuntoa, seurakuntasiipi sekä katutason liiketiloja.

Helsingin seurakuntayhtymän tavoitteena oli löytää ratkaisu, joka vähentää energiankulutusta ja päästöjä, mutta säilyttää samalla rakennuksen historiallisen ilmeen.

– Tavoitteenamme oli ensisijaisesti pienentää kohteen hiilijalanjälkeä osana kirkon ilmastotavoitetta. Samalla halusimme leikata lämmityskustannuksia, sillä kaukolämmön hinta oli noin kymmenessä vuodessa tuplaantunut, Helsingin seurakuntayhtymän tilapalvelupäällikkö Pekka Suominen kertoo.

Ennen lämpö karkasi katolta – nyt se kierrätetään takaisin käyttöön

Kiinteistössä oli jo ennestään koneellinen poistoilmanvaihto, mikä mahdollisti lämmöntalteenoton toteuttamisen ilman laajoja ilmanvaihtojärjestelmän muutoksia.

title: Palkittu geenitutkimus selvitti long Covid -oireyhtymän riskitekijöitä
content:
Some people experience persistent symptoms for months or even years after a coronavirus infection. This condition is known as long COVID. Common symptoms include debilitating fatigue, brain fog and respiratory problems.

One of the key findings of the award-winning study was that genetic susceptibility to long COVID is linked to the regulation of lung function. In particular, the FOXP4 gene emerged as an important factor, helping researchers better understand the cellular mechanisms underlying long COVID.

The study was led by Hanna M. Ollila, a group leader at the Institute for Molecular Medicine Finland (FIMM), University of Helsinki.

The interdisciplinary study analysed genetic data from more than one million people across 16 countries. In Finland, the researchers used data from FinnGen, which includes more than half a million biobank participants.

According to Ollila, the findings highlight the importance of FinnGen and other population-based studies in understanding chronic conditions that develop following infections.

title: Tutkijat: Pohjois-Euroopan vanhojen metsien tunnistamiseen tarvitaan yhteinen tieteellinen perusta
content:
Kansainvälinen tutkijaryhmä on julkaissut kokoavan katsauksen, jossa esitetään tieteeseen perustuvia kriteerejä Pohjois-Euroopan vanhojen metsien tunnistamiseen.

Julkaisu on tarkoitettu valtioiden rajat ylittäväksi tueksi päättäjille ja viranomaisille, jotka toteuttavat EU komission vaatimusta tunnistaa ja suojella jäljellä olevat vanhat ja luonnontilaiset metsät.

Vanhat metsät kuuluvat Euroopan arvokkaimpiin mutta samalla uhanalaisimpiin luonnonekosysteemeihin. Karkean arvion mukaan enää noin kolme prosenttia Euroopan metsistä täyttää luonnontilaisen tai vanhan metsän kriteerit. Niiden määrä vähenee edelleen myös Pohjois-Euroopassa.

Vanhojen metsien merkitys luonnon monimuotoisuudelle perustuu muun muassa metsien rakenteelliseen vaihteluun ja pitkän ajan kuluessa kehittyneisiin ekologisiin prosesseihin. Vanhat ja kuolleet puut sekä lahopuu tarjoavat elinympäristöjä esimerkiksi sienille, jäkälille, sammalille, lahopuusta riippuvaisille hyönteisille ja kolopesijöille.

title: STT: Polttoaineiden hinnoista kärsiville helpotusta tukipaketilla – tällainen ehdotus on hallituksen pöydällä
content:
STT:n tietojen mukaan hallituksen neuvotteluissa on pöydällä paketti, jolla tuettaisiin polttoaineiden korkeista hinnoista eniten kärsiviä autoilijoita.

Kyse on ennemminkin kymmenien miljoonien kuin satojen miljoonien eurojen suuruisesta tuesta, hallituslähteistä kuvaillaan. Hallitus joutuu rahoittamaan tukitoimet säästämällä muualta.

Nyt pöydällä olevat keinot ovat kohdennettuja toimia työmatkoihin ja ammattiliikenteeseen. Asunnon ja työpaikan välistä työmatkakuluvähennystä oltaisiin hieman korottamassa nykyisestä ja ammattiliikenteelle kaavaillaan pientä tukea. Hallituslähteistä kerrotaan, että jakeluvelvoitteen taso olisi pysymässä entisellään, mutta siihen olisi tulossa lisää joustoja.

Jakeluvelvoitetta koskevista toimista hallitus on päässyt STT:n tietojen mukaan yhteisymmärrykseen.

Jakeluvelvoitteessa on kyse siitä, kuinka suuren osan polttoaineesta tulee olla uusiutuvaa. Suomen jakeluvelvoite on tänä vuonna 19,5 prosenttia, ja ensi vuonna sen on määrä nousta hallitusneuvotteluissa sovitun mukaisesti 22,5:een.

title: Meet MEOW: An Easier Way to Discover Wikimedia Learning Resources
content:
Across the Wikimedia movement, people are creating presentations, publishing reports, organising workshops, and sharing lessons from their projects. These resources can help others develop new skills and build partnerships, but finding them is not always easy, because of the nature of the internet, they are spread across different platforms and languages, and useful experiences can be difficult to discover.

For this, MEOW (Metabase Educational Open Works, https://meow.toolforge.org/), offers an easier way to explore this shared knowledge. Whether you are preparing a workshop, planning a partnership, or learning about a new topic, it helps you find resources from across the movement.

MEOW is a free interface for browsing the resources cataloged in Metabase. It is easy to use and you do not need an account or any knowledge of query languages to use it.

title: UN: Burundi Set to Win Human Rights Council Seat Despite Abuses
content:
(New York) – Burundi is set to win re-election to the United Nations Human Rights Council in a vote on October 13, 2026, with no competition, Human Rights Watch said today. Burundi is seeking to retain its seat even though the government of this Central African country has not improved its abusive human rights conditions.

Burundi is one of the four African countries running for the same number of seats on the 47-nation council. The regional slates for the Western group, Latin America and the Caribbean, Central and Eastern Europe, and Asia also lack competition. This effectively guarantees all 15 candidates, fit or unfit, spots on the UN’s premier rights body for three years beginning on January 1, 2027. 

“This uncompetitive vote makes a mockery of the word ‘election,’” said Louis Charbonneau, UN director at Human Rights Watch. “UN member states should insist on competitive slates so they can reject candidates with poor human rights records. No one should have a seat on this crucial body handed to them on a silver platter.”

title: Fiji Criticized in U.S. Trafficking Report Over Failure to Tackle Grace Road Cult
content:
Fiji has been granted a one-year reprieve from a potential downgrade that could lead to U.S. aid cuts, amid concerns over its efforts to combat human trafficking, including its response to the Korean doomsday sect the Grace Road Group, according to a U.S. State Department report released last week.

This year’s Trafficking in Persons (TIP) report kept Fiji on its “Tier 2 Watchlist” of countries that do not fully meet the State Department’s minimum standards for combating human trafficking, noting that the Pacific island nation had failed to secure a trafficking conviction for three years running.

“Official complicity and corruption undermined anti-trafficking efforts and allowed traffickers to operate with impunity” in Fiji, the Oct. 8 report found.

However, the State Department granted Fiji a one-year waiver sparing it from being automatically downgraded to Tier 3, a designation that would have put it alongside countries including Iran and Afghanistan and could result in restrictions on U.S. non-humanitarian assistance.

Fiji, a country of just under a million people, has been on the Tier 2 Watchlist since 2024, but last year’s TIP report was the first to single out Grace Road.

title: How Europe plans to squeeze out Starlink
content:
BRUSSELS — Stepping on stage at the International Space Summit in Paris, French President Emmanuel Macron called on top European players to forge a new “alliance” to strengthen collective satellite capacity.

The real target of the let’s-team-up message? Elon Musk’s Starlink.

Macron’s speech last month was a public endorsement of a behind-the-scenes push that would see the bloc’s major telecoms companies make an aggressive play on direct-to-device connectivity — mobile signals beamed directly from satellites to phones.

On Tuesday, telecom ministers from EU national governments are gathering in Limerick, Ireland, to discuss a legislative proposal that could make it easier for top European carriers to get that satellite access.

The push would see Deutsche Telekom, Orange, Vodafone and Telefónica join forces to secure critical and coveted frequencies that will become available next year, as the European Commission eyes a new allocation procedure that would reserve frequencies for European players.

The plan, reported by Bloomberg ahead of Macron’s Sept. 10 speech, was confirmed to POLITICO by two people aware of the talks.

title: Economics Nobel: how this year’s winners helped to smooth the cycle of economic peaks and troughs
content:
The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences has awarded this year’s Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences to the American economists Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford. The prize was awarded in recognition of their development of macroeconomic models that helped to reduce the length and depth of economic downturns.

According to the Academy, the economists’ work in macroeconomic modelling has given policymakers additional tools to smooth out the economic cycle. As well as reducing the severity of downturns, their work also helped to cool the potentially negative impacts of economic booms.

Economies are known to follow cycles of downturns and upturns – and economists have long sought to find ways to tame these. More than a century ago, British economist John Maynard Keynes developed an approach to managing the economy that came to be known as Keynesianism.

Before this, the classical “laissez-faire” approach dominated. According to this doctrine, in an economic downturn, markets would eventually clear and the economy would rebound. Any attempt by government to directly influence the economy would not work and could even make things worse.

title: Hallituksen ennallistamissuunnitelmalle pyyhkeitä: aiheuttaja maksaa -periaate puuttuu
content:
Suomen ympäristökeskus (Syke) kritisoi hallitusta siitä, että kustannukset ennallistamisesta sysätään yksin valtiolle. Ennallistamisella tarkoitetaan toimenpiteitä, joilla ihmisen muokkaaman ympäristön tilaa pyritään parantamaan.

Kansallisen ennallistamissuunnitelman luonnoksen mukaan ennallistaminen on yksityisille maanomistajille vapaaehtoista ja heidän on mahdollista saada tukia ennallistamistoimiin.

- On poliittinen valinta, että ennallistaminen halutaan toteuttaa vain valtion kannustimien tai korvausten kautta. Poliittisesti voitaisiin valita myös toisella tavalla, sanoo Syken erikoistutkija Sampo Pihlainen STT:lle.

Ennallistamistoimien vuosittainen hintalappu on suunnitelmaluonnoksessa 1,2 miljardia euroa, josta valtio maksaa 900 miljoonaa. Yksityiselle sektorille maksettavaa jää 208 miljoonaa euroa, mikä tulee vesien- ja merenhoitoon liittyvistä toimenpiteistä. Loput kustannuksista katetaan EU-tukirahoilla.

Pihlainen pitää ongelmallisena, että suunnitelmasta puuttuu aiheuttaja maksaa -periaate.

- Se tarkoittaa sitä, että jos tapahtuu luonnolle haittaa aiheuttavaa toimintaa, vaikkapa raivataan metsää rakentamisen tai pellon tieltä, siitä joutuisi maksamaan, Pihlainen sanoo.

title: Report on the Arrest of Baha’i Citizen Zhila Sadeghi in Isfahan
content:
According to HRANA, citing IranWire, Zhila Sadeghi, a Baha’i citizen, has been in detention for six days.

According to the report, Ms. Sadeghi was arrested at her home in Isfahan on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, by agents of the Ministry of Intelligence and transferred to Dowlatabad Prison in the city. She is currently being held in one of the prison’s solitary confinement cells.

The report further states that, in addition to arresting this Baha’i citizen, the agents confiscated her family’s vehicle.

At the time of this report, no information has been obtained regarding the reasons for Ms. Sadeghi’s arrest or the charges brought against her.

Zhila Sadeghi (Moghen), a Baha’i citizen residing in Isfahan, is the mother of Sarir Moqen, another Baha’i citizen imprisoned at Dowlatabad Prison. Sarir Moghen has also been held in solitary confinement at Dowlatabad Prison in Isfahan for more than a month and a half.

title: Books or Bombs? France’s Student Revolt vs. NATO’s Spending Push
content:
By Medea Benjamin

NEW YORK | 12 October 2026 (IDN) — For the third week in a row, high school students across France are taking to the streets demanding more investment in their education. They want more teachers, smaller classes, decent school buildings and a public education system that works for poor and working-class students.

But their struggle comes at a moment when France faces mounting pressure to cut public spending while dramatically increasing its military budget. The question at the heart of this uprising goes far beyond education: Will France invest in its young people—or in missiles, weapons and war? Books or bombs?

What began in the Paris suburbs has spread to more than a thousand schools. On 6 October, more than 250,000 people reportedly took to the streets to support the students.

title: Taija Tuominen ja Maritta Lintunen kirjailijavieraina Hämeenlinnan pääkirjastossa
content:
Hämeenlinnalaiset kirjailijat Taija Tuominen ja Maritta Lintunen kertovat uutuusromaaneistaan informaatikko Jenni Jorun yhteishaastattelussa.

Taija Tuomisen Rauhaniemi-romaani (2026) kysyy, voiko kohtalonsa valita. Teos on tarkoin vedoin piirretty tarina valinnoista, jotka jäävät tekemättä, ja rakkaudesta, joka on valmis kestämään lähes mitä tahansa. Mikä saa toiset lähtemään ja toiset jäämään?

Iiris on kaikkea mitä pikkuveli Ilmari ei ole: kaunis, valoisa ja täynnä elämää. Ilmari rakastaa siskoaan enemmän kuin mitään muuta. Kun sisarukset kasvavat, Iiris suuntaa yliopistoon ja jättää taakseen pikkupaikkakunnan, mutta Ilmari jää. Jää vaikka kotikylällä ei ole muuta tarjottavaa kuin muistot ja vaikka elämä lipuu ohitse ilman että mistään saa otetta. Pikkuhiljaa myös mantereelta toiselle liehottava sisko alkaa muuttua vieraaksi ja menneisyyden tapahtumat asettuvat uuteen valoon. Mitä jää, jos muistoihin ei voi luottaa?

Maritta Lintusen Halla-romaani (2026) on jylhä romaani neljästä naisesta neljällä vuosisadalla. Teos kertoo tarinan selviytymisestä ja eri sukupolvien naisista, joita yhdistää kotitila Halla – turvapaikka maailman kuohujen keskellä.

title: Hungarian Ad Agency Got Millions From Firm Owned by Orban’s Billionaire Friend
content:
Just a few years after launching in 2020, Megafon Digital Incubator Center had become one of Hungary’s most influential political advertising agencies, mainly running social media campaigns in support of the ruling party and its leader, Viktor Orbán. 

But Megafon appears to have lost its sense of purpose since Orbán was swept from power in national elections this past April. Four months after that stunning loss, its website was taken offline.

Now, internal documents from a firm called V-Híd Zrt reveal the source of much of Megafon’s income. Around $12 million in donations came from that company, which is owned by Lőrinc Mészáros, Orbán’s childhood friend. 

Mészáros became fabulously wealthy during Orbán’s 16 years in power, building a business empire spanning sectors from construction to banking and energy. Mészáros’ companies won seven percent of all public procurement contracts — together worth about $2 billion — between 2018 and 2020 alone, according to Transparency International.

title: Donald Trump aligns with Vladimir Putin yet again, leaving Ukraine – and US relations with Europe – under pressure
content:
The deal struck by Donald Trump with his Russian counterpart, Vladimir Putin, on October 9 to allow Russia to sell millions of tonnes of diesel is a major departure from US policy and runs counter to Ukrainian and European interests. It also directly contradicts a law signed by the US president in September to authorise fresh US sanctions and tariffs on nations that import Russian oil and gas.

The timing of this deal was unfortunate. A senior Ukrainian and European delegation were in Miami for talks with Trump’s envoys, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner. On the table were apparently new US proposals which included a pre-winter de-escalation in the four-and-a-half-year war.

Once in the room, the US envoys reportedly signalled that sanctions relief on Russia was coming. But this still left Ukrainian and European officials blindsided by the announcement. Unsurprisingly, the talks ended the same day without any agreement and a day earlier than planned.

title: CIVICUS at the 89th Ordinary Session of the African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights
content:
The 89th session of the African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights (ACHPR) will be held in Dakar, Senegal, from 11 to 20 October, preceded by the NGO Forum, which will take place from 8 to 10 October.

The Forum on the Participation of NGOs provides an important platform for civil society organisations to share updates on the human rights situation across Africa and engage in collective advocacy ahead of the ACHPR session. The Forum will cover three main thematic areas: 

  • Status of human rights and democracy in Africa: Updates from sub-regional focal points on the general situation.
  • Special interest group discussions, which will allow participants to identify recommendations to address challenges raised in panel discussions.
  • Networking for human rights in Africa: Sharing experiences, best practices and lessons learnt towards durable solutions for forced displacement in Africa.

    • Under these themes, the Forum will deliberate on the following sub-themes: 

  • Water, sanitation, and the right to development
  • Civic space, governance, and democratic integrity
  • Natural resources, environmental justice, and climate-induced migration
  • Peace, security, and human rights

title: Elina Hirvonen: Toivosta luopuminen on vain tekosyy olla toimimatta
content:
Olen viimeisten kolmen vuoden aikana seurannut tiiviisti, miten Afganistanissa asuvat naiset toimivat Talebanin jatkuvasti tiukentuneiden sääntöjen ja raaistuneen väkivallan keskellä.

Kun koulutus on tytöiltä kielletty, he opiskelevat netin kautta ja salaisissa kouluissa, joita opettajat pitävät yksityisasuntojen kellarihuoneissa.

Kun ravintolat, kuntosalit, kauneussalongit, julkiset kylpylät ja kaupungin puistot on tytöiltä ja naisilta suljettu, he perustavat salaisia lukupiirejä, jossa keskustelevat kielletyistä kirjoista.

Vaikka naiset eivät saa liikkua kaduilla ilman miespuolista saattajaa, naistenpäivinä Kabulin nuoret tytöt ovat menneet kaduille jakamaan ruusuja, muistuttamaan siitä, että naisten ihmisyys, unelmat ja halu elää vapaana ja osallistua yhteiskuntaan ei ääriliikkeen tavoitteista huolimatta katoa.

Olen pitänyt yhteyttä Afganistanin naisiin minun ja Talebanin hallitsemassa Kabulissa 1990-luvulla kasvaneen Shakiba Adilin yhteisen The Secret Reading Club of Kabul -elokuvan takia. Elokuvan tavoite on nostaa Afganistanin naisten äänet maail­man kuuluviin ja heidän oikeutensa yhteiselle asialistalle.

title: From Madagascar to Accra: Reflections from the Language Diversity Conference 2026
content:
Participating in the Language Diversity Conference 2026 in Accra, Ghana, was a meaningful experience for me, both personally and as someone working to strengthen the presence of the Malagasy language in the digital world.

The conference brought together more than 100 language activists, Wikimedians, researchers, and heritage workers representing 82 languages. For three days, Accra became a space for sharing experiences, learning from different communities, and discussing how languages can remain visible and active in an increasingly digital world.

The conference opened with Jara dance, Nbangba Cultural Troupe from Ghana, immediately bringing a strong sense of culture, identity, and community into the event. It was a beautiful way to begin a conference about languages. Before the keynote, presentations, and discussions even started, we were already seeing that language is closely connected to culture, traditions, identity, and the way communities express themselves.

That cultural atmosphere remained present throughout the conference.

I was particularly happy to see the Malagasy language represented at an international conference dedicated to language diversity.

title: Two African Wars Put Civilians—and the UN’s Authority—at Risk
content:
Ethiopia and Eritrea trade accusations before the Security Council as another deadly strike hits displaced families in Sudan.

By Ramesh Jaura

BERLIN | ADDIS ABABA | KHARTOUM (IDN) — Wars in Ethiopia and Sudan are testing how far the United Nations can act when appeals for restraint are ignored.

Ethiopia and Eritrea have carried their rapidly escalating dispute to the Security Council. Farther west, a drone strike in Sudan’s Blue Nile state has killed dozens of displaced civilians, including women and children.

Although the conflicts have different origins, civilians in both countries are paying for failed agreements and delayed diplomacy.

Ethiopia told the Security Council that Eritrean troops had advanced as far as 60 kilometres into its territory. It described the reported incursion as an “all-out invasion” and asserted its right to self-defence.

Eritrea denied the allegation and submitted its own letter to the Council. It accused Ethiopia of manufacturing a pretext for war. It asked for condemnation and “deterrent measures” under Chapter VII of the UN Charter, which permits action ranging from sanctions to military force.
